Proven ownership of medium-to-high complexity features end-to-end (design → build → test → release/support). Strong collaboration and communication in cross-functional teams. Strong engineering fundamentals: clean, maintainable architecture, and well-tested code. Desired skills and competencies Experience with distributed systems and production diagnostics (logs/metrics/tracing, latency analysis, failure modes). Strong secure engineering mindset—auth modernization familiarity (OIDC/JWT), secure configuration/secrets, and dependency/vulnerability risk management.
